description: This file defines the FrameSelectors class and related types for querying and resolving DOM elements within frames in the Playwright testing framework. It includes methods for querying elements, handling frame navigation, and selector parsing.

classes.name: FrameSelectors
classes.description: Provides methods to query and resolve DOM elements within a specific frame, including handling complex selectors and frame navigation.

methods.name: _parseSelector
methods.description: Parses a selector string or object into a SelectorInfo, considering strict options.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Queries for a single element matching the selector within the frame or scope.

methods.name: queryArrayInMainWorld
methods.description: Returns a handle to all elements matching the selector in the main world of the frame.

methods.name: queryCount
methods.description: Counts the number of elements matching the selector.

methods.name: queryAll
methods.description: Returns all element handles matching the selector.

methods.name: resolveFrameForSelector
methods.description: Resolves the frame and selector info for a given selector, handling nested frames.

methods.name: resolveInjectedForSelector
methods.description: Resolves the injected script context and selector info for a given selector.
